art_direction: RoomScale category: settlement_structure. Create a compact Scavenger supply depot from recognizable reclaimed household and industrial parts. Preserve an open loading face, the existing 24 x 13 x 20 inch site envelope and gameplay-owned placement. Give it a broken asymmetrical roof made from large mismatched sheets and one patched fabric section, visibly carried by timber posts and braces. Build its walls from repaired drawer boards and salvaged appliance doors. Make the loading sill, hand-pulled rope hoist, wire storage baskets and a few slatted crates large enough to read at the 64-inch settlement camera. Use eclectic, visibly repaired construction and several broad material blocks for faction identity; avoid Clockwork gears, boilers, copper trim and decorative brass. Keep the rear and side structure stable, physically attached and recognizable from both settlement overview and close inspection.
